channel.title: The Grant Desk - Grants, AI, Tech & Research, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Grants, AI, Tech & Research, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: BRAID Creative Commissions 2027: A Promise in Return (Responsible AI, GBP 8,000-12,000, Edinburgh Art Festival)
item.description: BRAID (Bridging Responsible AI Divides), University of Edinburgh, with Inspace, the Institute for Design Informatics and the Edinburgh Futures Institute · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · Around seven commissions with budgets of GBP 8,000 to 12,000 each, inclusive of VAT and all costs. No application fee.

item.title: ART4MENTAL open call for artists: VR content for mental-health support (EUR 5,000 sub-grants)
item.description: ART4MENTAL (Creative Europe project) · deadline 11 Nov 2026 · Sub-grant of up to EUR 5,000 per artist for 20 selected artists (EUR 100,000 pool), plus VR training, mentorship, a residency in the Ukrainian Carpathians and exhibition opportunities. No application fee.

item.title: Zoud GameLab 2026: Global Game Jam financial-literacy jam (prize and funding pool up to USD 140,000)
item.description: Zoud (UAE National Financial Wellbeing and Sustainability Initiative) with Global Game Jam · deadline 15 Nov 2026 · Shared prize and development-support funding pool of up to USD 140,000 across best overall game, runner-up, third place, financial-literacy impact, regional perspective, compelling gameplay and a Best Game from the UAE award; individual prize amounts are not published. No entry fee.

item.title: City of Palo Alto Code:ART 2027: Interactive Media Installations (up to USD 9,000 each)
item.description: City of Palo Alto Public Art Program · deadline 16 Nov 2026 · Up to USD 9,000 per installation, for up to five installations. No application fee.

item.title: City of Palo Alto Code:ART 2027: Lytton Plaza Installation Commission (USD 20,000)
item.description: City of Palo Alto Public Art Program · deadline 16 Nov 2026 · USD 20,000 commission budget. No application fee.

item.title: MIT Solve: 2027 Global Challenges
item.description: MIT Solve (Massachusetts Institute of Technology) · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · Every selected Solver team receives a USD 10,000 grant funded by Solve, plus access to a pool of over USD 1 million in prize funding at selection and additional funding opportunities throughout the program. Sponsor prizes range from USD 100,000 to 200,000, including the AI for Humanity Prize (up to USD 150,000, Patrick J. McGovern Foundation), the Collegium Prize for Innovation (USD 100,000), the Citizens Workforce Innovation Prize (USD 100,000), the Crescent Enterprises AI for Social Innovation Prize (USD 100,000) and the Seeding the Future Prize (USD 150,000). No application fee.

item.title: GAIN SSA: AI Safety Essentials Fellowship (inaugural cohort)
item.description: GAIN SSA (Global AI Youth Network, Sub-Saharan Africa) · deadline 08 Nov 2026 · Micro-grant pool funding top capstone proposals at USD 500 to 1,000 each (capped at USD 1,000), usable for compute access, communication work such as Substack Pro subscriptions for writers, or travel to AI alignment conferences in Sub-Saharan Africa. The fellowship itself is free to attend (no participation fee, no application fee); no stipend is paid during the program.

item.title: Creative Industries Fund NL: Residency Videotage 2027 (Hong Kong)
item.description: Creative Industries Fund NL (Stimuleringsfonds Creatieve Industrie), with Videotage · deadline 21 Oct 2026 · One residency grant: EUR 5,000 for a two-month work period or EUR 6,500 for three months, covering travel, insurance, living expenses, compensation for time invested, and material and transport costs. Housing, work space, Videotage guidance and production costs are paid by the Fund directly to Videotage on top of the grant; accommodation is arranged by Videotage. No application fee.

item.title: OASis Bom Dia Residency 2027 at Cultivamos Cultura (Sao Luis, Portugal)
item.description: Cultivamos Cultura (European OASis project) · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · EUR 1,300 project fee, travel budget up to EUR 500, production and material expenses up to EUR 1,600 (pre-approved), food per diem, plus free accommodation in a private room in a shared farmhouse and access to a workspace or studio and all Cultivamos Cultura spaces and resources.

item.title: Screen Australia Future Leaders Delegation: BitSummit 2027 (Kyoto)
item.description: Screen Australia · deadline 05 Nov 2026 · AUD 6,000 per delegate towards flights, accommodation, event tickets, ground transportation and meals, plus covered travel costs for the pre-departure workshop and the opportunity to exhibit a game on the Australia stand. Up to eight delegates.

item.title: make-a-thek: Mobility Scheme & Knowledge Exchange Programme (Europe + pilot countries)
item.description: make-a-thek (coordinated by Fab Lab Barcelona at IAAC, funded by Horizon Europe) · deadline 01 Dec 2026 · Mobility Scheme: EUR 1,000 flat stipend for experienced practitioners. Knowledge Exchange Programme: EUR 850 flat stipend. Up to 12 participants per track annually. No application fee.

item.title: EU CERV: European Remembrance 2026-27 (CERV-2026-CITIZENS-REM)
item.description: European Commission / EACEA (Citizens, Equality, Rights and Values Programme) · deadline 24 Feb 2027 · EUR 50,000 to EUR 500,000 per project, from an estimated call budget of EUR 28 million (EUR 14M Holocaust remembrance of Jewish victims; EUR 5M genocide, war crimes and crimes against humanity incl. Roma and LGBTIQ+ victims; EUR 5M colonialism, slavery and migration; EUR 4M democratic transitions). No application fee.

item.title: Onassis ONX: ONX Seeds 2026, Soft Circuits for Hard Times (Athens, hybrid)
item.description: Onassis ONX (Onassis Foundation) · deadline 26 Oct 2026 · EUR 1,000 to 5,000 seed funding per project, set by scope; up to four projects selected. Plus weekly technical, curatorial and business mentoring, online masterclasses, studio and equipment access at Onassis Ready for Athens-based teams, and presentation at ONX Exhibition Athens (17 to 21 March 2027) with travel, accommodation and artwork transport covered for non-Athens participants. No application fee.

item.title: Burning Man: BRC Honoraria Art Grants 2027 (Letter of Intent)
item.description: Burning Man Project · deadline 29 Oct 2026 · USD 1.5 million annual art-grant budget across approximately 75 projects; grants fund 40 to 60% of the proposed total budget, and the official page notes grants over USD 20,000 are rare. No fixed per-award figure is published. No application fee.

item.title: Fondation Vocatio: Bourse Vocatio 2027 (EUR 10,000 for young talents in Belgium)
item.description: Fondation Vocatio · deadline 29 Oct 2026 · EUR 10,000 bourse per laureate, funding a concrete personal project (equipment, production, training). No application fee.

item.title: Finnish Cultural Foundation: October Round 2026 (all fields of art and science)
item.description: Finnish Cultural Foundation (Suomen Kulttuurirahasto) · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · Around EUR 49 million awarded annually across roughly 2,100 grants; recent October rounds have averaged over 450 working and project grants covering one or more years, with working grants extending up to four years. No application fee.

item.title: Swarovski Foundation: Creatives for Our Future 2026/27 (Global Grant for Emerging Creatives)
item.description: Swarovski Foundation · deadline 09 Nov 2026 · EUR 20,000 grant per selected participant, plus a mentorship and education programme. No application fee.

item.title: Beam Center: 2027 Beam Camp Project Open Call (USD 5,000 commission, remote-friendly)
item.description: Beam Center · deadline 30 Nov 2026 · USD 5,000 award to the selected proposer, plus a fabrication budget of approximately USD 15,000. No application fee.

item.title: ARDC: Amateur Radio and Digital Communications Grants (January 2027 round)
item.description: Amateur Radio Digital Communications (ARDC) · deadline 15 Jan 2027 · No fixed range is stated on the apply page, but ARDC's published 2026 grant portfolio shows awards from USD 1,285 up to USD 258,000 (for example GNU Radio 4 at USD 258,000). No application fee.

item.title: Anthropic Economic Futures Research Fund (research grants on AI's economic impacts)
item.description: Anthropic · deadline Rolling / undated · USD 200 million committed overall. Grants primarily in the USD 5-30 million range per project, with a USD 1 million minimum and flexibility upward for well-scoped, high-potential-impact projects. The separate small-grant Research Awards tier (USD 10,000-50,000 plus USD 5,000 in Claude API credits) is currently paused. No application fee.
